disclaimer: Unofficial curated catalog. Not affiliated with TypeSafe AI. Benchmarks are attributed, not endorsed.

entries.title: Jev Ultrafast browser agent
entries.short_description: Uses Jev to pick the next browser operation and target from an indexed DOM; a small LLM only types text.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Drives Chrome through a local inspector. The README documents a Google Flights search example. It does not book flights.
entries.jev_role: Choice of operation plus speculative target questions in one request
entries.caveats: Timing and cost claims in the README were not remeasured. Jev is text-only; the page is serialized to text/DOM, not pixels.

entries.title: TypeSafe Mario
entries.short_description: Uses Jev to choose NES controller macros from emulator RAM JSON, not screenshots.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Local play loop writes run JSONL. A dashboard shows action distribution.
entries.caveats: The ROM is not in the repo. Interactive demo, not a shipped product. No native vision.

entries.title: TypeSafe Computer Use
entries.short_description: OCRs a Mac screen, then Jev chooses the next UI action and the code clicks.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Local screenshot → OCR → Choice/Noul → OS action loop.
entries.jev_role: Action selection on OCR text state

sources.what_verified: API description plus typesafe_sdk imports; 168 stars 2026-09-17
sources.author: awlevin

entries.caveats: Not native vision. Per-step cost in the GitHub description is an author claim.

entries.title: Jev Review
entries.short_description: Runs staged Jev judgments over git diffs or a local codebase and shows them on a dashboard.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: JSON reports plus a dashboard on 127.0.0.1:4317. Does not publish reviews remotely.
entries.jev_role: Noul risk matrix, Choice/Score file profiles, evidence selection, severity routing
entries.caveats: Developer tool, not a hosted CI product. Thresholds are code policy.

entries.title: pg-jev
entries.short_description: PostgreSQL helpers that filter, sort, or classify rows with Jev.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: SQL helpers call TypeSafe. Rows that match a Noul, Choice, or Score filter are returned by the database.

sources.what_verified: README SQL API and install notes
sources.author: realZachi

entries.caveats: Needs untrusted plpython3u / superuser. Row text is sent to TypeSafe. Latency numbers in the README were not re-run.

entries.title: pi-warden
entries.short_description: Asks Jev whether a Pi agent tool call is irreversible or off-task before it runs.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Steers or blocks Pi tool calls. Published as a pi.dev package.
entries.jev_role: Judgments on proposed tool calls, stuck loops, unverified done claims

sources.what_verified: GitHub description and repo exist; 44 stars 2026-09-17
sources.author: DevMortimer

sources.what_verified: Package page extracted in Reddit lane
sources.author: pi.dev

entries.caveats: Did not re-run against a live Pi session.

entries.title: Foreman

entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Semantic supervision of coding workers (per README/description).
entries.caveats: Full README walkthrough was partial; grounded on import evidence and description.

entries.title: beadsort
entries.short_description: Uses Jev to label beads issues from their text.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Writes labels onto beads items from issue text.
entries.jev_role: Classification / labeling Choice or Noul over issue state

sources.what_verified: Public repo; description verified via GitHub API 2026-09-17
sources.author: harrymunro

entries.caveats: 0 stars at check time; launch-week. Source tree not fully walked in this sweep.

entries.title: JEVMETER

entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: CLI wizard writes a .jevmeter.mp4.

sources.what_verified: Repo exists; README wizard described in GitHub lane
sources.author: ChetasLua

entries.caveats: Audio is transcribed then scored as text. Jev is not a native audio model. Accuracy badges are author claims.

entries.title: blink
entries.short_description: Walks the filesystem and uses Jev to score which files match a natural-language query.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: CLI table of paths with percentages.
entries.caveats: Prototype search, not an index. May issue many parallel Jev calls.

entries.title: neo4jev
entries.short_description: Walks a Neo4j graph by asking Jev which neighboring relationship to follow.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Graph navigation demo: classifier over edge types / neighbors.
entries.caveats: Small demo (6 stars). README not fully re-read in the owner pass.

entries.title: semdecide
entries.short_description: Turns Jev judgments into Unix pipeline exit codes or JSON.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: CLI exit codes / JSON from Jev judgments on stdin or files.
entries.caveats: Small project. Do not treat as a standard library.

entries.title: jev-router
entries.short_description: Uses Jev to pick a model for each Claude Code or Codex request.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: jev-claude / jev-codex launch real upstream CLIs with a routed model.
entries.caveats: README uses JEV_API_KEY, not TYPESAFE_API_KEY. npm registry page was not separately opened.

entries.title: Jev Codex Router
entries.short_description: Classifies each Codex Router turn with Jev, then code picks model, effort, and tier.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Local jev_server.py with fail-open and a JSONL decision log.
entries.jev_role: Turn classification plus routing policy in code
entries.caveats: Backtest savings are author-measured. Fail-open means a Jev outage does not block coding.

entries.title: SkillRanker
entries.short_description: Ranks which agent skill fits the next step from live session context.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: sr demo (offline fixtures) or sr rank --allow-network; optional Claude Code hook.
entries.caveats: Offline demo is fixtures. Live ranking needs a TypeSafe key.

entries.title: Official skill-suggestion cookbook
entries.short_description: Two Jev requests rank 182 Hermes skills and may suggest none.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: suggest() returns at most one skill name for the agent system prompt. Published table: wrong-skill loads 16.8% → 7.3% on a pinned Haiku run (author numbers).
entries.jev_role: Choice over the roster plus Nouls for whether a skill is needed

sources.what_verified: Cookbook method, mermaid, published table, jev-1.12 / Haiku pin, rendered 2026-07-31
sources.author: TypeSafe

entries.caveats: Numbers are TypeSafe's published eval, not reproduced here. Not a drop-in Hermes skill.

entries.title: Jev Agent Skill Router
entries.short_description: Routes over a skill catalogue with Jev Choice and Noul gates; it does not load the skills.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Returns a routing decision with call evidence. Does not load or execute skills. Author-recorded synthetic 72-case run versus a lexical baseline.
entries.jev_role: Parallel Choice over catalogue batches; final Choice plus need, review, and per-candidate fit Nouls; Python applies thresholds

sources.what_verified: README plus router.py, transport.py, policy.py; 3 stars; no skill execution
sources.author: GodsBoy

entries.caveats: Native x_search named this repo without a status citation; GitHub independently inspected. Benchmark is 24 synthetic skills / 72 requests, not a live Hermes catalogue. CLI name jev-router collides with gargpratyush/jev-router. 3 stars. Accuracy numbers are author-recorded, not re-run here.

entries.title: Jev email intent workflow

entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Prints intent, probabilities, and destination vs expected label. Does not send mail or pay invoices.

sources.what_verified: README graph; tests mock the SDK
sources.author: GiesN

entries.title: Official function-calling cookbook
entries.short_description: Maps a natural-language trading request onto typed functions and closed-set arguments.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Dispatcher returns a function name plus Literal arguments with confidence; ordinary Python functions run.
entries.jev_role: Choice over tools and closed-set args; Nouls for whether an arg was stated
entries.caveats: Uses cached cookbook results unless you delete json_cache.json. Example domain is market data plots, not live brokerage.

entries.title: Official LLM guardrails cookbook
entries.short_description: Screens an LLM input or output for hazards, then code chooses pass, review, block, or support.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: guard() returns a policy action. Does not send the user message itself.
entries.jev_role: Nouls per hazard plus a harm Score
entries.caveats: Thresholds are yours. Cached published run unless you go live.

entries.title: Official citation-check cookbook
entries.short_description: Checks whether a quote's context supports a claim.
entries.actual_actions_or_outcome: Choice plus confidence can flag a citation for human review.
entries.jev_role: Choice: supports / does not support / uncertain

sources.what_verified: Listed in llms.txt with method summary
sources.author: TypeSafe

entries.caveats: Cookbook page listed in the official index; not fully re-read beyond the index blurb in this owner pass.

entries.title: Official intent-routing pattern

entries.caveats: Pattern, not a packaged product.
